page: Microsoft Azure L96as_v4 is a storage and memory-optimized server belonging to the Lasv4 family, powered by AMD EPYC 9V74 processors. It features 96 vCPUs mapped to 48 physical cores using Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization on an x86_64 architecture. The processor operates at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz and includes 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core, and includes 23,038 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capability. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

In benchmark testing, the L96as_v4 demonstrates top-tier multi-core CPU performance, ranking in the top 10% for stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU tests. Single-core performance is strong, placing in the top 25% across stress-ng and Geekbench single-core evaluations. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with small-block cached read operations reaching top-tier speeds of 7,287.47 GB/sec, while large-block uncached read and write operations maintain strong top 25% performance. The server also excels in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and software compilation, both scoring in the top 10%.

This server is highly suited for large-scale database operations, data warehousing, and heavy multi-threaded processing tasks. The combination of 23 TB of local storage and 768 GB of RAM provides high resource density, making it a cost-efficient choice for storage-heavy workloads that require rapid local I/O without the overhead of external storage arrays. While it delivers strong performance for medium-sized LLM inference tasks, its lack of dedicated GPU hardware makes it less optimal for large-scale AI training or high-throughput real-time text generation on massive models.
description: Microsoft Azure L96as_v4 is a storage-optimized server from the Lasv4 family, featuring 96 vCPUs and 48 physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor running at 3.7 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture under Microsoft Hyper-V, it delivers 768.0 GB of system memory and a massive 23,038 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capabilities. Benchmark results place this server in the top 10% for multi-core CPU performance, software compilation, and cached memory bandwidth. It also demonstrates strong top-25% performance in database operations, static web serving, and medium-model LLM inference. Lacking a GPU, the L96as_v4 is highly cost-efficient for data-intensive, storage-heavy workloads, making it an excellent fit for large-scale databases, data warehousing, and multi-threaded data processing.
